meta.name: ponytail-debt
meta.description: Harvest every `ponytail:` comment in the codebase into a debt ledger, so the deliberate shortcuts and deferrals ponytail leaves behind get tracked instead of rotting into "later means never". Use when the user says "ponytail debt", "/ponytail-debt", "what did ponytail defer", "list the shortcuts", "ponytail ledger", or "what did we mark to do later". One-shot report, changes nothing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码注释中生成技术债务清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用特殊注释标记了技术债务却无人跟进
copy.tagline_en: Generate a debt ledger from code annotations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you mark technical debt with special comments but no one follows up

howto.what: Claude 会扫描代码库中所有以 `ponytail:` 开头的注释，生成一份债务账本，列出每个标记的位置、简化内容、上限和升级触发条件。没有升级路径的标记会被标记为“无触发”。最后报告总数。
howto.when: 当你说出“ponytail debt”、“/ponytail-debt”、“what did ponytail defer”等触发词时启动。一次性任务，完成后自动停止。

say.note: 扫描代码库并生成债务报告。
查看所有被延迟的事项。
列出所有代码捷径标记。

howto.what_en: Claude scans the codebase for all `ponytail:` comments and compiles them into a debt ledger, listing each marker's location, simplification, ceiling, and upgrade trigger. Markers without a trigger are flagged. Ends with a summary count.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "ponytail debt", "/ponytail-debt", "what did ponytail defer", or similar phrases. One-shot report, reverts after completion.

say_en.note: Scans code and generates the debt report.
